## sqlpipe v2.0

This release includes a breaking change to the `/v2/users` response.

The `name` field no longer appears in the response.

The response now contains separate `first_name` and `last_name` fields.

If your client reads `name`, update the client to read both new fields.

The release adds the `--incremental` flag.

Use this flag to process only records that changed after the previous run.

The flag reduces processing time for data sources with frequent updates.

Parquet writes now run 40% faster in benchmark tests.

The speed improvement applies to standard Parquet output.

Existing commands continue to work without the `--incremental` flag.

Test integrations that consume `/v2/users` before you deploy this release.

Update schemas, serializers, and validation rules that use the removed `name` field.
